messages:
ida: quick sync — we've had 3 incidents this week where hosted->private credential rotation caused 502s for dedicated fallbacks.
ida: root cause looks like the adapter layer not atomically switching keyrefs; it reads old key while token is revoked.
mike: ugh. saw that. happens when the probe sequence overlaps rotation window. short window but high traffic -> bursty failures.
sanjay: is this the same CFA/bridge path where we copy creds into the sidecar? or the new resolver flow?
ida: both paths. the resolver helps but its cache invalidation is racy. sidecar copy is a different bug (file rename race).
kelly: this feels like an interface boundary issue — credential lifecycle is leaking implementation assumptions across hosting modes.
ida: exactly. proposal: define a small "credential-resolver" contract with 3 ops: fetch(keyid)->ref, refresh(ref)->ref, retire(ref). make transitions idempotent.
mike: sounds good. tradeoff: adds a roundtrip for hosted callers unless we support local caching with strong invalidation hints.
sanjay: can we piggyback invalidation on the existing lease/heartbeat channel? e.g. resolver emits tombstone events to adapters.
kelly: yes. pattern: resolver owns authoritative ref; adapters hold a short-lived lease token that maps to ref; on retire resolver emits tombstone + new-ref mapping.
ida: pseudo-config sketch:
```
credentialResolver:
  type: external
  endpoint: rslv.k8s.svc.cluster.local:8080
  lease_ttl: 10s
  invalidation_channel: /leases/cred
```
ida: ops-bot: runbook note — when rotating keys, update resolver first, then rotate backend. don't rotate both at once.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Runbook link: https://intranet/runbooks/credential-rotation
mike: implementation risks: latency bump and additional failure domain. mitigations: async refresh, optimistic local fallback, circuit-breaker.
kelly: next steps: (1) write mini-RFC for credential-resolver contract (2) prototype local lease cache in adapter (3) add e2e test across hosted/dedicated/private flows.
ida: timeline: RFC this week, prototype next sprint. volunteers? @mike @sanjay
mike: i'll take adapter prototype.
sanjay: i'll own resolver RFC + test harness.
kelly: I'll update the rollout playbook and add canary gating rules.
ida: thanks. logging: make sure adapter emits resolver.ref_id and resolver.lease_id for correlation. short thread, will follow up with RFC link.
